Galician

[edit]

Noun

[edit]

galinha f (plural galinhas, reintegrationist norm)

  1. reintegrationist spelling of galiña

Further reading

[edit]
  • “galinha”, in Dicionário Estraviz de galego (in Galician), 2014–2026

Kabuverdianu

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Inherited from Portuguese galinha, from Old Galician-Portuguese galinha, from Latin gallīna.

Noun

[edit]

galinha

  1. hen
  2. chicken

Old Galician-Portuguese

[edit]

Alternative forms

[edit]
  • galỹa, galinna

Etymology

[edit]

Inherited from Latin gallīna (“hen”), from gallus (“rooster”).

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ɡa.ˈli.ɲa/, /ɡa.ˈlĩ.j̃a/

Noun

[edit]

galinha f (plural galinhas)

  1. hen
    • a. 1284, Alfonso X of Castile, Cantigas de Santa Maria, Códice de los músicos, cantiga 308 (facsimile):
      a outra […] foi com ouo de galỹa
      the other […] had the size of a hen’s egg

Descendants

[edit]
  • Galician: galiña
  • Portuguese: galinha (see there for further descendants)

Further reading

[edit]
  • Universo Cantigas - "galinha"

Portuguese

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese galinha (“hen”), from Latin gallīna (“hen”), from gallus (“rooster”). By surface analysis, galo +‎ -inha.

Compare Galician galiña.

Pronunciation

[edit]
 
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /ɡaˈlĩ.ɲɐ/ [ɡaˈlĩ.j̃ɐ], /ɡaˈʎĩ.ɲɐ/ [ɡaˈʎĩ.j̃ɐ]
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /ɡaˈlĩ.ɲɐ/ [ɡaˈlĩ.j̃ɐ], /ɡaˈʎĩ.ɲɐ/ [ɡaˈʎĩ.j̃ɐ]
    • (Southern Brazil) IPA(key): /ɡaˈli.ɲa/, /ɡaˈʎi.ɲa/
  • (Portugal) IPA(key): /ɡɐˈli.ɲɐ/

  • Rhymes: -iɲɐ
  • Hyphenation: ga‧li‧nha

Noun

[edit]

galinha f (plural galinhas)

  1. hen
  2. chicken (meat)
    Synonym: frango
  4. (Brazil, slang, derogatory) a person (especially a woman) who is almost never single

Derived terms

[edit]
  • galinha caipira
  • galinha-d'angola
  • galinhaço
  • galinhada
  • galinhame
  • pé de galinha
  • pé-de-galinha
  • pele de galinha

Related terms

[edit]
  • galinheiro
  • galo

Descendants

[edit]
  • Kabuverdianu: galinha
  • Papiamentu: galiña

Adjective

[edit]

galinha m or f (plural galinhas)

  1. (Brazil) who is virtually always seen with a partner
